# How to Succeed at Small Business Local Marketing in a Global World

[Sean Standberry](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/author-bio-sean/)

Co-Founder

Last updated: August 14, 2026 •

[](https://www.linkedin.com/in/seanstandberry)[](https://www.instagram.com/seanstandberry/)

The Internet has changed everything. We shop differently. We socialize differently.

We work differently. Much of the change has had positive effects.

But it’s also forced many small businesses to utilize local [marketing tactics](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/marketing-tactics/ "marketing tactics") to compete against giant companies online.

It’s made it so much easier for businesses around the globe to offer services at rates you can’t compete with.

You can spend a lot of wasted time and money trying to compete in this global marketplace head-on.

Or you can get smart about local marketing.

Even if you have national or global aspirations, your local market is your point of power when you know how to leverage it.

Let’s look at steps you can take now to do just that.

Takeaways

*   If you’re marketing broadly when you don’t have to, you’re spreading your resources razor-thin.
*   The great thing about [digital marketing campaigns](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/digital-marketing-campaign/ "digital marketing campaigns") is that there are a lot of options for targeting specific groups of people.
*   Local marketing helps local business work to their strengths to do more with less and succeed.

## **Local Marketing? Start With Local SEO!**

Local marketing is the process of targeting new customers based on their proximity to your business.

For example, if you want to see more customers in the same city as you, then you’d use location marketing strategies to advertise to them.

Local search engine optimization (SEO) is a big part of location marketing.

Now you’ve probably heard of [local SEO](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/local-seo/). But you may not realize just how important it is to a local business.

Without taking steps to optimize your [website](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/importance-of-a-website/ "website") for local search results, you’re competing with every website on the Internet.

Instead, you could be competing in your local market and winning at it.

### **Let Us** **Grow Your Revenue...** 

✅ Increase revenue with done-for-you marketing

✅ Custom marketing strategy backed by data and results

✅ Affordable marketing services with no long-term contract

             

GET A CUSTOM PROPOSAL  🎉

If you’re marketing this broadly when you don’t have to, you’re spreading your resources razor-thin. Getting a decent ROI is nearly impossible.

Local [SEO](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/what-is-seo-and-how-it-works/ "SEO") turns the impossible into possible.

But it’s not automatic. Google doesn’t just see that you’re local and give you preferential treatment.

You have to clearly demonstrate that you’re a local business and that you’re the best among your local competitors.

Search engines use what is referred to as local signals from:

*   Social media
*   Other local websites
*   Review sites
*   And more

These establish that you’re indeed a local business.

Why do they need so much proof? It’s so people can’t easily fake being a local business to take advantage of local SEO. It’s powerful stuff.

Let’s walk through the steps you need to take to optimize for local searches.

## **5 Steps For Local Marketing Search Engine Optimization**

### **1\. Put User Experience First**

If you’re already investing in SEO, you may have already taken this step. But it must be mentioned. SEO starts with a responsive [website design](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/effective-website-design/ "website design").

Make sure your site is loading as fast as possible.

Marketing analytics firm, Kissmetrics found a clear connection between load time and people abandoning the site.

For every additional second, it takes to load, you’re losing visitors.

Make sure it’s mobile-friendly. Over 50% of website [traffic](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/blog/increase-website-traffic-fast/ "traffic") now comes through mobile devices.

If you’re not making sure that your website is user-friendly on mobile, you’re losing another half of your potential customers.

50% of people who visit a local business on mobile, will visit the physical location within 24 hours, according to [Hubspot](https://www.hubspot.com/). You need this traffic.

Make it easy to navigate. You’re just trying to be helpful.

But people get confused by too many choices.

They appreciate it when you narrow it down. Keep navigation simple and straightforward.

Use analytics to determine how people interact with your site.

In hyper-competitive local marketplaces, small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) need to stand out to succeed. The key is to implement proven local marketing strategies that attract nearby customers, boost visibility, and foster strong community connections.

From building an unbeatable online presence with Google Business Profile (GBP) to leveraging creative offline tactics, this guide breaks down 9 must-try local marketing strategies that every small business should use in 2025.

Whether you're looking to engage your community, drive foot traffic, or grow online leads, these tips will help your business thrive in the local landscape.

## Try These 9 Local Marketing Techniques To Drive More Business

### 1\. Optimize Your Google Business Profile

Your Google Business Profile is the foundation of any successful local marketing strategy. With over 1 billion people using Google Maps every month, your GBP is essentially a bustling digital storefront, helping you reach potential customers nearby when they're looking for products or services like yours.

**Quick Tips:**

*   Keep your business name, address, and phone number accurate and consistent.
*   Post regularly (photos, offers, and updates).
*   Encourage happy customers to leave glowing reviews.

### 2\. Expand Visibility with Local Directories

Don't stop at Google! Listing your business on other relevant directories like Yelp, Tripadvisor, or niche platforms for your industry (e.g., OpenTable for restaurants) expands your reach even further. It also helps [build valuable local citations](https://www.localfalcon.com/blog/where-why-and-how-to-build-local-citations), which can increase your business's rankings in local search results.

*   **Why It Works:** Local citations improve SEO and build trust.
*   **Pro Tip:** Use [local SEO tools](https://www.localfalcon.com/blog/what-are-the-most-effective-local-seo-tools) to automate listing updates across multiple platforms.

### 3\. Dominate Search with Google Local Services Ads (LSAs)

If you're a service-based business, [Local Services Ads (LSAs)](https://www.localfalcon.com/blog/how-to-grow-your-business-by-using-googles-local-services-ads-for-lead-generation) can bring high-quality leads straight to you.

**What Makes LSAs Great:**

*   You only pay for actual leads (calls, messages, bookings).
*   LSAs appear above all search results, grabbing attention instantly.

Local content marketing can set you apart from competitors by showcasing your community ties and establishing you as a leader in your industry and area.
